title: Beyond Driving: Envisioning Activities in Future Autonomous Vehicles through Experience-Centered Design
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) are poised to fundamentally alter personal transportation, offering occupants the freedom to engage in various non-driving-related activities (NDRAs). However, our current understanding of how people might actually use this time in fully autonomous vehicles (FAVs) is limited.
